_comment: Professor's own self-hosted install record. pfm reads installed_from.repo alone, as the theme source owner (pfm/internal/installer/themes.go); mode and answers record the install interview for humans.

answers.tagline: the discipline layer for Claude Code
answers.mission: Ship a transplantable engineering-discipline layer that any repo can adopt, whose gates read artifacts instead of trusting reports.
answers.domain: AI agent orchestration and prompt engineering frameworks
answers.intersection_lens: prompt engineering x epistemology of evidence — the judge must never be the thing being judged
failure_modes_watched: the honest-looking absence (a check that reports its own broken state as a clean result)
drift between .claude/** and its templates/** twin
a private project's identifiers leaking into the public blueprint
dangling pointers in shipped templates (a command naming a file no install produces)
context-budget bloat past the 35KB command / 15KB agent caps
sacred_ground: the leak line — no private brand, user PII, client domain content, or machine-absolute path in any tracked file
the publication line — push/tag/release only on an explicit in-turn request
